title: 第一卷 第13章 懂事的张娴雅第一卷 第14章 你要妹妹不要
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 半个时辰后。
曹阳穿戴整齐，叮嘱道：“这些灵石和那枚一阶七品丹药你用着吧，先提升修为。”
说完，便在张娴雅不舍的目光中离开了。
回到自己住的破旧茅草屋。
曹阳四下打量了一番。
屋顶漏风，墙壁渗水，只有一张硬板床。
对比张娴雅那布置得清幽雅致的单独院落，简直是天壤之别。
“得赶紧把丹侍的身份弄到手，只要成了丹侍，不仅能有院子，还能名正言顺地接触更多的废丹。”
曹阳盘腿坐在硬板床上，盘算起自己现在的处境。
他有净元之体，四人魂，修为炼气三层巅峰
但应对敌人的手段太匮乏了。
他需要法器，需要符箓，更需要高阶功法。
可这些东西都得用灵石啊。
曹阳摸了摸怀里的一百多块灵石，苦笑一声。
不说别的，就说张娴雅今天用的那张一阶二品清神符，少说也得三百灵石。
更别提，他还在掌生阁欠着三千五百块下品灵石的巨债。
“买现成的太亏了，性价比最高的办法，还是利用阴阳造化鼎合成。”
曹阳心思活络起来。
阴阳造化鼎既然能把废丹合成高阶丹药，那功法呢？
法器残片呢？
符箓废纸呢？
只要提供原材料和足够的阴阳之气，理应也能变废为宝。
他现在修炼的《引气诀》只是最不入流的凡级功法，灵力运转慢得可怜。
如果能去藏经阁买几本残缺的功法，合成一部黄级功法，他的战力会有所提升，修为提升速度想来也能增长一些。
想到这里，曹阳不再犹豫，直奔落云宗的藏经阁。
落云宗藏经阁建在半山腰，是一座三层高的雄伟木楼。
每天进出这里的弟子络绎不绝。
曹阳顺着青石台阶来到藏经阁大门前。
刚要迈步往里进，忽然有个人拦住了他，“站住。”
“想进藏经阁缴纳三块灵石。”
曹阳听到这声音，面色立刻阴沉下来，停下脚步抬头看去。
这人一身落云宗外门弟子服饰，身形干瘦，颧骨高耸，一双三角眼中透着几分飞扬跋扈。
他认得这个人。
此人名叫赵光裕。
虽然只有炼气三层的修为，但他有一个掌管藏经阁的大伯，在外门可谓是横着走。
仗着这层关系，赵光裕常年蹲守在藏经阁门口，专门拦截那些没有天赋也没有背景的底层弟子进行勒索。
之前曹阳还是炼气一层杂役的时候，每次来藏经阁都被他盯上。
因为刘管事和范建的层层克扣，曹阳连半块灵石都掏不出来，只能被迫给赵光裕干苦力顶账，每次都累得脱层皮。
因此，曹阳极少涉足此地。
content_en:
Half an hour later.
Cao Yang was dressed neatly and warned: "You can use these spiritual stones and the first-order seventh-grade elixir to improve your cultivation first."
After saying that, he left under Zhang Xianya's reluctant eyes.
Return to the dilapidated thatched house where you live.
Cao Yang looked around.
The roof leaked, the walls leaked, and there was only a hard bed.
Compared to Zhang Xianya's quiet and elegant separate courtyard, it was a world of difference.
"We have to quickly get the identity of the Dan Shi. As long as we become the Dan Shi, we will not only have a yard, but also have legitimate access to more useless pills."
Cao Yang sat cross-legged on the hard bed and considered his current situation.
He has a pure body, four human souls, and is at the peak of the third level of Qi refining.
But the means to deal with the enemy are too scarce.
He needs magic weapons, talismans, and even more advanced techniques.
But these things all require the use of spirit stones.
Cao Yang touched the more than a hundred spiritual stones in his arms and smiled bitterly.
If nothing else, let’s just say that the first-order and second-grade Shen Shen Talisman that Zhang Xianya used today cost at least three hundred spirit stones.
Not to mention, he still owes a huge debt of 3,500 low-grade spiritual stones in Zhangsheng Pavilion.
"It's too much of a loss to buy it ready-made. The most cost-effective way is to use the yin and yang creation cauldron to synthesize it."
Cao Yang's mind became active.
Since the Yin-Yang Fortune Cauldron can synthesize waste elixirs into high-level elixirs, what about the techniques?
Where are the artifact fragments?
Where is the talisman waste paper?
As long as raw materials and enough yin and yang energy are provided, it should be possible to turn waste into treasure.
The "Qi-Inducing Technique" he is currently practicing is only the most inferior ordinary-level technique, and the movement of spiritual power is pitifully slow.
If he could go to the Tibetan Scripture Pavilion to buy a few incomplete exercises and combine them into a yellow-level exercise, his combat power would be improved, and his cultivation speed would probably increase as well.
Thinking of this, Cao Yang no longer hesitated and went straight to Luo Yun Sect's Sutra Pavilion.
The Luoyun Sect Sutra Collection Pavilion is built on the mountainside and is a majestic three-story wooden building.
There is an endless stream of disciples coming in and out here every day.
Cao Yang walked along the bluestone steps to the door of the Sutra-Tiding Pavilion.
Just as he was about to step inside, someone suddenly stopped him and said, "Stop."
"I want to enter the Sutra Collection Pavilion and pay three spiritual stones."
When Cao Yang heard this voice, his expression immediately darkened, he stopped and looked up.
This man was dressed in the attire of an outer disciple of the Luoyun Sect. He had a thin figure, high cheekbones, and a pair of triangular eyes that looked domineering.
He recognized this man.
This person's name is Zhao Guangyu.
Although he is only at the third level of Qi Refining, he has an uncle who is in charge of the Sutra Pavilion and can be said to be running sideways in the outer sect.
Relying on this relationship, Zhao Guangyu squatted at the door of the Tibetan Scripture Pavilion all year round, specifically to intercept low-level disciples with no talent or background for blackmail.
Before, when Cao Yang was a handyman on the first level of Qi Refining, he would keep an eye on him every time he came to the Sutra Pavilion.
Because of the layers of deductions from Manager Liu and Fan Jian, Cao Yang couldn't even take out half of the spirit stone, so he was forced to work hard for Zhao Guangyu, and he was so tired that he peeled off every time.
Therefore, Cao Yang rarely set foot here.
